newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Communist head to Israel, Palestinian areas.
newsitem.headline: French Communist head to Israel, Palestinian areas.

text.p: French Communist Party (PCF) chief Robert Hue will next month become the first PCF leader to visit Israel and self-ruled Palestinian areas, his office said on Wednesday.
Hue, who softened his party's stance after taking over from veteran Stalinist Georges Marchais nearly in 1993, will spend three days each in Israel and Palestinian areas from March 3.
The French Communist party has long supported Palestinians but was virulently hostile to Israel until Hue took over, moderating the party's stance to make it more even-handed.
